groups.merge_rationale: Specific airport-proximity location preference; distinct from downtown preference or a general preference to stay near a user-specified local anchor.
Specific downtown-area preference for city hotel selection; distinct from airport proximity and from proximity to an explicitly named trip anchor.

Both candidates apply when the trip request names a concrete local anchor such as an attraction, venue, beach, area, transportation hub, or natural feature, and both prioritize hotels close to that anchor; the walking-distance phrasing is an operational detail of the same anchor-proximity behavior.
